# Chrono notice provenance

The unmodified LICENSE.txt is from the Cargo registry source of chrono 0.4.45,
whose archive checksum is pinned in Cargo.lock. The desktop uses this crate
with default features disabled and only the std feature, for UTC display of
modified timestamps. It does not supply the file comparator or locale collation.
The crate offers MIT OR Apache-2.0 licensing. Dependency source and complete
notice packaging remain part of release preparation.
